Got it, you’re essentially trying to do two things at once:

1) Point your **website (neweraintel.com)** to your new Luxora site  
2) Keep **email (Google Workspace Gmail)** working on neweraintel.com  

Those are controlled by **different DNS records**, so you can safely do both without breaking email 👍

---

# ✅ What You Actually Need to Change

### 1. Website → Uses **A Record / CNAME**
### 2. Email → Uses **MX Records (leave these alone)**

---

# 🔧 Option A (Recommended): Redirect neweraintel.com → theluxorcollective.co

If your goal is to **send all traffic to your new domain**, the cleanest way is:

### In GoDaddy DNS for `neweraintel.com`:

#### A Record (Root Domain)
```
Type: A
Host: @
Value: 76.223.27.102
```

#### CNAME (www)
```
Type: CNAME
Host: www
Value: theluxorcollective.co
```

👉 This works well if your Luxora site is hosted on platforms like Showit, Webflow, or similar.

---

# ⚠️ CRITICAL: Do NOT Touch These (Email)

Make sure these stay exactly as-is:

### MX Records (Google Workspace)
They should look like:
```
ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
```

### Also keep:
- TXT records (SPF)
- DKIM records
- DMARC (if you have it)

👉 These control your Gmail.  
👉 Changing A records will NOT affect email.

---

# 🔁 Option B (Better for Branding): Forward Instead of DNS Pointing

If you don’t want to mess with IPs, GoDaddy has a simpler option:

### Domain Forwarding:
- Forward `neweraintel.com` → `https://theluxorcollective.co`
- Use **301 Permanent Redirect**
- Enable **forward with masking OFF**

This is honestly the cleanest for your situation.

---

# 💡 Pro Tip (What I’d Do If I Were You)

Given your rebrand:

- Keep **neweraintel.com email active** (for legacy contacts)
- Forward the domain → Luxora
- Eventually transition to **@theluxorcollective.co email**

---

# 🚨 Common Mistake to Avoid

Do NOT:
- Replace MX records
- Delete TXT records
- Point MX to Luxora domain

That will break your Gmail instantly.

---

# If You Want — I Can Check It For You

If you drop:
- Where Luxora site is hosted (Showit, Webflow, etc.)
- Screenshot of your DNS

I’ll tell you EXACTLY what to change line-by-line so nothing breaks.

Perfect, since your **Luxora site is on WordPress**, here’s the exact clean setup so:

✔ neweraintel.com → shows Luxora site  
✔ Gmail (neweraintel.com) → keeps working  
✔ No downtime / no broken email  

---

# ✅ Step 1: Get Your WordPress Hosting IP

This depends on where your WordPress is hosted (not WordPress.com, but hosting like Bluehost, SiteGround, WP Engine, etc.).

👉 Go into your hosting dashboard and find:
- “Server IP” or “Shared IP”

---

# 🔧 Step 2: Update GoDaddy DNS (for neweraintel.com)

### A Record (ROOT DOMAIN)
``` id="wp1"
Type: A  
Host: @  
Value: [YOUR WORDPRESS SERVER IP]
```

---

### CNAME Record (WWW)
``` id="wp2"
Type: CNAME  
Host: www  
Value: theluxorcollective.co
```

---

# ✅ Step 3: Add Domain in WordPress

Inside your WordPress hosting:

- Add **neweraintel.com** as an **addon domain** or **alias domain**
- Or set up a **301 redirect** to:
  ```
  https://theluxorcollective.co
  ```

👉 Most hosts have a simple “Redirect” tool

---

# 🔒 Step 4: Keep Email Working (MOST IMPORTANT)

DO NOT TOUCH:

### MX Records (Google Workspace)
They must stay pointing to Google:

- ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM
- ALT1, ALT2, ALT3, ALT4

Also keep:
- SPF (TXT)
- DKIM
- DMARC

👉 These are what keep your Gmail alive

---

# 💡 Best Setup (What I Recommend for You)

Since you’re rebranding Luxora:

### ✔ Use **301 Redirect**
Instead of loading two sites

👉 Redirect:
- neweraintel.com → theluxorcollective.co

This:
- Keeps SEO clean  
- Avoids duplicate content  
- Fully transitions your brand  

---

# ⚡ EASIEST METHOD (Honestly do this)

Inside **GoDaddy**:

1. Go to DNS
2. Scroll to **Forwarding**
3. Set:
   - Forward to: `https://theluxorcollective.co`
   - Type: **301 Permanent**

👉 DONE. No A record needed.

---

# 🚨 Quick Reality Check

If your goal is:
- “Retire New Era Intel brand”
- “Move everything to Luxora”

👉 Forwarding > DNS pointing

---

# If you want, I can audit your exact setup

Send me:
- Screenshot of GoDaddy DNS  
- Who hosts your WordPress (WP Engine, Bluehost, etc.)

I’ll literally mark up exactly what to change so nothing breaks.
